svg.title: P04: Middleware-pipeline loop
svg.desc: Analytical UML class view of the proposed pattern contract; not an observed implementation or execution trace.
svg.text: Primitive / UML CLASS VIEW / ANALYTICAL MODEL

text.tspan: Layer behavior around model/tool calls.

svg.text: dashed arrow: call dependency · brown: return/failure · analytical, not an observed trace

text.tspan: A harness surrounds model or tool invocation with extensible behavior.
A call enters or leaves the runtime boundary.
Ordered middleware entries with a continuation or short-circuit result.
Logging, policy, retry, or context behavior runs in declared order.
The boundary exposes a composable continuation contract.
Middleware executes in deterministic order and the final result reaches the
loop.
A middleware does not silently bypass required downstream layers.
Short circuits and exceptions unwind deterministically with one terminal
result.
1 Invocation → MiddlewareChain enter(call)
2 MiddlewareChain → Middleware invoke(call)
3 Middleware → ExecutionTarget continue(call)
4 ExecutionTarget ↩ MiddlewareChain return(result)
5 MiddlewareChain → Invocation return(result)
6 MiddlewareChain ↩ ExceptionHandler unwind(error)
7 ExceptionHandler ↩ Invocation fail(error)
Registration order, retry, redaction, tracing, and policy middleware.
Test order, short circuit, exception, and repeated side-effect calls.
A hard-coded helper call is not a middleware pipeline.
